items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Well, sometime, like Ray Batiste, well, he could play in one key.

ctx.x: Yes, that would be kind of difficult to be playing all night long and scared to make a wrong chord or anything and make it a lot harder, I'd imagine, in those days.

Well, yeah, you'd always try, you see, at that time, because you knew they was going to try to, you, it was going to ignore you, you know. So you'd always try to make as closer to them chords as you could, see. Of course, sometime he'd play better than the other fella, like they had a couple of good piano players here then at that time, you know, was playing around here. Well, sometime, like Ray Batiste, well, he could play in one key. You see, lots of them fellas could play in one key. Well, that, them fellas…
Yeah, they couldn't play in brass and-
